title: Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS): Integrating Established Prioritization Operators for Priority Elicitation in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
abstract: arXiv:2608.21187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pairwise reciprocal matrices are fundamental to the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a decision-making model. While the Direct Least Squares (DLS) method provides an intuitive mechanism for deriving priority vectors without complex transformations, the DLS provides multiple solutions. Under high levels of inconsistency, such as cyclic contradictions, this non-convexity yields multiple distinct global minima, resulting in unstable priority rankings that critically depend on initial algorithmic guesses. To overcome this structural deficiency, this paper introduces the Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS) optimization model. ARDLS integrates uniquely determined established prioritization operators, such as normalization techniques, the Eigenvector method, Singular Value Decomposition, Cosine Maximization, and the Pseudo-Inverse Gram Matrix (the closed-form solution of Weighted Least Squares), as theoretical anchors within a

translated_title: 锚定正则化直接最小二乘法（ARDLS）：在层次分析法中整合既有优先级提取算子用于偏好诱导
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21187v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：成对互反矩阵是决策模型层次分析法（AHP）的基础。尽管直接最小二乘法（DLS）提供了一种无需复杂变换即可推导优先级向量的直观机制，但DLS存在多个解。在高不一致性（如循环矛盾）下，这种非凸性会产生多个不同的全局最小值，导致优先级排名不稳定，且严重依赖于算法的初始猜测。为克服这一结构性缺陷，本文引入了锚定正则化直接最小二乘法（ARDLS）优化模型。ARDLS将唯一确定的既有优先级提取算子（如归一化技术、特征向量法、奇异值分解、余弦最大化以及伪逆Gram矩阵（加权最小二乘的闭式解））作为理论锚点，整合在优化模型中。
tldr: 本文提出ARDLS方法，通过将多种经典优先级提取算子作为锚点嵌入优化模型，解决了DLS在非一致情况下的多解问题，从而稳定了AHP中的优先级排名。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ARDLS, which anchors established prioritization operators into the optimization model to resolve the multiple-solution issue of DLS under inconsistency, thereby stabilizing priority rankings in AHP.
